a: Up to 5% of competed MeerKAT time, for small projects
dt: Proposals can be submitted at any time by email (one PDF, at most 3 pages)
e: MeerKAT radio telescope time for small projects that cannot be proposed through the Open Time call, typically transients, or that are likely to lead to rapid high-impact papers. Proposals must justify why MeerKAT is the best instrument and include data-processing and publication plans.
unv: The DDT page does not state PI eligibility; the MeerKAT Open Time call is open to researchers at any institution, including postdocs and PhD students.
